authoring: Manually constructed circles, rounded rectangles, lines and Bezier curves. No extracted font glyph coordinates, raster tracing or Apple image data are used in these production paths.
design: SF-style monochrome interface geometry; these are project designs, not reproductions or exports of SF Symbols.
runtime: The authored Core Graphics command tables remain available on every supported iOS release. iOS13+ prefers public SF Symbols for the toolbar keys below, using the requested point size, Regular weight and Medium scale. A missing system symbol returns to the authored path; iOS12 uses the authored paths throughout. The Grid-only build uses the grid key for its fifth toolbar item. All images retain template tinting. No font outlines or SF image assets are exported or embedded.
availability_source: Apple SF Symbols2.1 name_availability.plist: SHA-256627fda54a3341c8bd2b2aeec63ea0379a03a5b71c1ca12b328b0b3928cdbdac4. Its2019 and2020 entries map to iOS13.0 and14.0 respectively. Public UIImage symbol lookup determines actual runtime availability and nil preserves the authored fallback.
scope: Interface symbols only. Pencil color-selection artwork, analytic Spectrum content and the recovered UIColorPickerWell ring are separate resources or renderers and are not reauthored by this change.
supersedes: The former eight SFProDisplay-derived production outlines and six extracted macOS toolbar/pipette images. Historical source records remain separate from these project-authored paths.
